IR-01.name: Initial incident report
IR-01.text: At 10:05 AM, a worker slipped on standing water in the west aisle next to Bottle Filler F-2 and injured a knee. The source of the water was unknown when this report was filed.

CAM-17.name: Camera review worksheet
CAM-17.text: Camera-review worksheet C-17: At 09:50 AM, a cleaner is shown mopping next to the west aisle of Bottle Filler F-2.

COR-17.name: Unsolicited correction of camera label
COR-17.text: Correction to worksheet C-17: The camera feed was mislabeled. The 09:50 AM mopping occurred in the East Annex beside F-4, not the west aisle of F-2.

MNT-81.name: Maintenance ticket
MNT-81.text: Maintenance ticket M-81: At 09:45 AM an operator reported a loose coupling on the F-2 rinse-drain hose. Repair work began at 10:25 AM. The ticket contains no incident-time measurement of water flow.

OPS-02.name: Equipment function note
OPS-02.text: Equipment note for F-2: During filling operation, rinse water flows through a flexible drain hose to a floor receptor. If a hose coupling is loose, rinse water may escape onto the surrounding floor. This note describes the intended setup, not the actual incident configuration.

WIT-06.name: Witness statement
WIT-06.text: Witness statement W-6: At approximately 10:01 AM I saw water dripping from the F-2 rinse-drain hose coupling onto the west aisle floor. Water extended into the worker walking path. I did not check when the coupling became loose.
